What this agent does

A travel research assistant that answers with real data — it looks up coordinates and historical climate (Open-Meteo), visa policies (Wikipedia), and live flight prices (Duffel sandbox). Every answer it produces is cached in Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey, so repeated or similar questions stop costing LLM tokens.

Try this sequence to see the cache work:

  1. Ask something new, e.g. "I'm a US citizen planning a trip to Tokyo. Do I need a visa, and when is the best time to go?" — cold run: the agent explores and calls its tools (badge agent ran, several cycles, most tokens).
  2. Ask a paraphrase of the same question, e.g. "As an American visiting Tokyo, what visa do I need and which season is nicest?" — the cached reasoning kicks in: badges plan hint and tool cache hits, fewer cycles, and a green saved count.
  3. Ask for flights, e.g. "Cheapest flight from JFK to Tokyo on 2026-09-15" — prices cache for only 5 minutes (volatile data); repeat within 5 min to hit the cache, after that it re-fetches live prices.
  4. Works in any language — ask in Spanish against an answer learned in English and the similarity match still hits.

Badges explained: agent ran full run  ·  plan hint reasoning reused from a similar past question  ·  N API calls saved external API invocations avoided (latency + third-party cost, not tokens)  ·  N saved tokens the equivalent cold run would have cost. The cache is global — savings carry across users and sessions.
